module_summary: Pipelined unsigned 8x8 multiplier: registered operands, shifted partial products summed in a registered adder tree, with an enable shift register producing output valid.

anchors.name: mul_out
anchors.why: Registered 16-bit product output, zeroed when the delayed enable is low.

anchors.name: mul_en_out
anchors.why: Output valid, delayed copy of mul_en_in through the enable pipeline.

anchors.name: mul_en_in
anchors.why: Input valid; gates operand capture and starts the enable shift register.

anchors.name: mul_en_out_reg
anchors.why: 3-bit enable shift register; MSB gates mul_out load and feeds mul_en_out.

anchors.name: mul_a_reg
anchors.why: Registered multiplicand, zeroed when input enable low.

anchors.name: mul_b_reg
anchors.why: Registered multiplier; its bits select each partial product.

anchors.name: temp
anchors.why: Eight shifted partial products of mul_a_reg gated by mul_b_reg bits.

anchors.name: sum
anchors.why: Four registered pairwise partial-product sums, first adder-tree stage.

anchors.name: mul_out_reg
anchors.why: Registered final product, sum of the four partial sums.

groups.name: enable_pipeline
groups.description: Shift register delaying input enable to align output valid with product.

groups.name: operand_stage
groups.description: Captures operands when enabled, otherwise zero.

groups.name: partial_product_tree
groups.description: Shift-and-add partial products reduced through two registered adder stages.
